question: I want to take a walk through the bottom tip of Manhattan, from the Battery up toward Chinatown and Tribeca. Which neighborhoods have some of their land inside that stretch, and which borough does each one belong to?
sql: SELECT zone, borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.69, -73.97, 40.73)) ORDER BY zone

question: For each borough, how far north, how far south, how far east and how far west does its land reach?
sql: SELECT borough, MIN(ST_YMin(geometry)) AS south, MAX(ST_YMax(geometry)) AS north, MIN(ST_XMin(geometry)) AS west, MAX(ST_XMax(geometry)) AS east FROM nyc_taxi_zones GROUP BY borough ORDER BY borough

question: How many taxi rides started in the neighborhoods that sit completely inside the rectangle stretching from Midtown over to the Upper East Side, and what was the average fare for those rides?
sql: WITH box AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.00, 40.74, -73.94, 40.80) AS env), inside_zones AS (SELECT z.location_id FROM nyc_taxi_zones z, box WHERE ST_Within(z.geometry, box.env)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, AVG(t.fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN inside_zones iz ON t.PULocationID = iz.location_id
skills: joining trips to spatially filtered zones

question: Which pairs of neighborhoods from different boroughs have rectangular outlines that overlap, meaning their boxes touch even if the real shapes do not?
sql: SELECT a.zone AS zone_a, a.borough AS borough_a, b.zone AS zone_b, b.borough AS borough_b FROM nyc_taxi_zones a JOIN nyc_taxi_zones b ON a.location_id < b.location_id WHERE a.borough <> b.borough AND ST_Intersects(ST_Envelope(a.geometry), ST_Envelope(b.geometry)) ORDER BY zone_a, zone_b LIMIT 20

question: Which neighborhood sits farthest north in the city, and how many taxi rides were picked up there during January 2024?
sql: WITH northmost AS (SELECT location_id, zone FROM nyc_taxi_zones ORDER BY ST_YMax(geometry) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT n.zone, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM northmost n JOIN nyc_taxi_trips t ON t.PULocationID = n.location_id GROUP BY n.zone

question: Show me the outlines of the neighborhoods that reach furthest toward the southern edge of the city, along with how many rides started in each of them.
sql: WITH southern AS (SELECT location_id, zone, ST_YMin(geometry) AS south_edge, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS outline FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_YMin(geometry) < 40.52) SELECT s.zone, s.south_edge, s.outline, COUNT(t.PULocationID) AS pickups FROM southern s LEFT JOIN nyc_taxi_trips t ON t.PULocationID = s.location_id GROUP BY s.zone, s.south_edge, s.outline ORDER BY s.south_edge LIMIT 5
skills: CTE with left join to trip counts
